description: Use this when the person wants to change where a made clip starts or ends, or to cut out any stretch in the middle, in seconds on the clip (get_clip_edit gives the word times). remove [{start_seconds, end_seconds}] cuts stretches (sound, picture and their captions); restore [...] puts cut stretches back. Edges move to the nearest gap between words. A clip keeps at least 3 seconds. Saves the clip only, no render.

clip_id.description: The clip's id (from get_episode, get_job or the Slice link).

name: set_trim

open_in_slice.description: The clip in the Slice editor, where the person sees the change.

title: Trim a clip
